t: $(item)Powercells$() store massive amounts of power. They can be placed either individually, or they can be placed next to one another to form a multiblock structure. Powercells will automatically distribute RF between themselves and their neighbors, and will join up into a multiblock regardless of tier.
$(item)能量单元$()可以存储海量能量。它们既可以单独放置，也可以相邻放置以形成多方块结构。能量单元会自动在自身与相邻单元之间分配 RF，并且无论阶级如何都可以组成多方块结构。

Powercells have no UI, but can be configured to input, output, or ignore power by hitting the desired side with a $(l:rftoolsbase:tools/smartwrench)smart wrench$() in $(thing)Wrench Mode$(). Blue is input, Yellow is output, and a blank side is neither.
能量单元没有界面，但可以用处于$(thing)扳手模式$()的$(l:rftoolsbase:tools/smartwrench)智能扳手$()敲击所需侧面，将其配置为输入、输出或忽略能量。蓝色为输入，黄色为输出，空白面则两者都不是。
By default, the $(item)Powercell (low)$() can hold 500,000RF each.
默认情况下，$(item)能量单元（低）$()每个可存储 500,000 RF。
By default, the $(item)Powercell (Medium)$() can hold 4,000,000RF each.
默认情况下，$(item)能量单元（中）$()每个可存储 4,000,000 RF。
By default, the $(item)Powercell (high)$() can hold 20,000,000RF each. That's a lot of RF!
默认情况下，$(item)能量单元（高）$()每个可存储 20,000,000 RF。真是相当多的 RF！
